items.title: Wash and dry
items.text: Then see what is torn and what can be used

items.title: Unpick
items.text: Open the seams, never cut, to keep whole pieces

items.title: Press flat
items.text: Fronts, backs, waistbands and pockets apart

items.title: Grade
items.text: Sort into three shades, each kept together

items.title: Lay out and piece
items.text: Piece whole lengths, then cut the pattern

notes: Turning an old pair of jeans into fabric I can cut takes five steps. The key one is the second: I open the original seams rather than cutting across them, so every piece keeps its full size and the old topstitching and seam marks survive. In the fifth step I join whole lengths of fabric first and only then cut the pattern, so I decide where the seams fall.
